fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: The owner of any mine, who shall direct or permit any person to enter a mine in violation of the provisions of this section, shall be punished by a fine of not less than $100.00 nor more than $500.00 for each and every offense.
fair-exchange.quote_gets: A person elected to any other public office shall not be eligible for election as an inspector of mines, nor for appointment as a deputy inspector.
